title.zh-CN: 恶心呕吐与腹泻 · 78岁女性
title.en: Nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea · woman aged 78

summary.zh-CN: 老年患者伴糖尿病和进食不足，急诊输液后出现新症状；用时间线和床旁检测识别药物安全问题。
summary.en: An older patient with diabetes and poor intake develops symptoms during an emergency infusion; use timing and bedside measurements to assess medication safety.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期、职业身份细节已去除。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。

text.zh-CN: 先静脉输注奥美拉唑，后接续左氧氟沙星；后者约10分钟出现症状。细菌性腹泻仅为当时临床考虑，无病原确证记录。
text.en: Omeprazole was infused first, followed by levofloxacin; symptoms began about ten minutes into the latter. Bacterial diarrhoea was suspected but no pathogen confirmation is documented.

text.en: Before infusion the ECG was normal and the chest film showed no obvious abnormality.

text.zh-CN: 原报告首次暂停左氧氟沙星并补糖后好转，但未复测血糖；医师恢复输液，约5分钟后再次症状并测得1.9 mmol/L。再次停药、静脉补糖后意识恢复，末次血糖9.6 mmol/L。复盘把这次再激发作为风险事件，而非推荐做法；长期随访未载。
text.en: The report describes improvement after pausing levofloxacin and giving glucose, without repeat glucose measurement. Infusion was restarted and symptoms recurred about five minutes later at 1.9 mmol/L. Stopping the drug and giving intravenous glucose again restored consciousness; the final glucose was 9.6 mmol/L. Rechallenge is reviewed as an unsafe event, not recommended practice; long-term follow-up is unavailable.

text.zh-CN: 症状性低血糖，应怀疑输液相关药物反应并核对其他诱因
text.en: Symptomatic hypoglycaemia with a suspected infusion-related drug reaction; review other contributors

feedback.zh-CN: 低血糖是实测事实；禁食、既往降糖药及用药时间都要纳入，而不能凭短潜伏期排除。
feedback.en: Hypoglycaemia is measured; fasting, glucose-lowering therapy and timing all matter, and short latency does not exclude a drug contribution.

text.zh-CN: 只因输液很快就发作，排除左氧氟沙星参与
text.en: Exclude levofloxacin because symptoms appeared soon after infusion

prompt.zh-CN: 首次反应时怎样做最安全？

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。

text.zh-CN: 停止可疑药物，立即按专业流程纠正并复测血糖，评估意识及气道，避免再激发
text.en: Stop the suspected drug, promptly correct and recheck glucose under a clinical protocol, assess consciousness/airway and avoid rechallenge

feedback.zh-CN: 低血糖可严重或反复；症状改善不能代替复测，更不能以危险再激发作诊断试验。
feedback.en: Hypoglycaemia can be severe or recurrent; symptom improvement does not replace repeat testing, and dangerous rechallenge is not a diagnostic test.

text.en: Restart the infusion after symptom improvement to confirm causation by recurrence

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 时间关系、低血糖实测值和报告中的复现支持左氧氟沙星相关反应；今天的教学路径在首次反应就阻止再激发。
conclusion.en: Timing, measured hypoglycaemia and the reported recurrence support a levofloxacin-associated reaction; the educational pathway prevents rechallenge after the first episode.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正常初始肌酐不能消除老年糖尿病患者的药物风险。
keyReasoning.en: A normal initial creatinine does not remove medication risk in an older patient with diabetes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 再激发历史增加因果证据，但不能成为需要重做的步骤。
keyReasoning.en: Historical recurrence adds causal evidence but is not a step to repeat.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
